bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs (TestWindow, UI testing kit only); springboard/apps/assistant-desktop/src/model.rs (model runner, no eval harness)
summary: Apple's Evaluations framework measures the quality of intelligence-powered features: datasets, evaluators, metrics, model-judge scoring, tool-call trajectory checks and Swift Testing integration. BifrOSt has no model-quality evaluation harness. Its testing kit covers UI and app tests, and the Assistant app runs a model with no scoring.

features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The Assistant runs the model but has no way to define a suite and run it against samples.
